He had a documented deep vein thrombosis (DVT) in the affected leg 5 years ago but has no other significant past medical history.

Based on the 10-year history of bilateral swelling, the family history of similar problems, the prior DVT, and the location of the wound on the right lower leg, the clinical picture is classic for chronic venous insufficiency.
